eliminarDatos.title: Data deletion
eliminarDatos.metaDescription: How to ask SOSColombia to delete personal data you submitted.
eliminarDatos.intro: If you submitted a name, phone number, address, or other contact detail through a form on this site ("Suggest an aid point" or "Suggest a post") and want it deleted, here's how.
eliminarDatos.queHeading: What you can ask us to delete
eliminarDatos.queTexto: Any contact detail (email or phone) or personal information you submitted through a site form. The site doesn't create public user accounts, so there's no profile to delete — just the specific data you sent in.
eliminarDatos.comoTexto: Since the site has no public login, we can't verify your identity automatically — a moderator reviews each request by hand. Reach us on Instagram or open a GitHub issue (links in every page's footer) and include:
eliminarDatos.comoItem1: What you submitted (e.g. the aid point's name, or the link of the suggested post).
eliminarDatos.comoItem3: The contact detail you want deleted, so we can locate it.
eliminarDatos.tiempoHeading: What happens next, and how long it takes
eliminarDatos.tiempoTexto: We'll confirm the deletion within 30 days at most. If the data was already part of an approved, public aid point or post, we'll remove the associated contact detail — the already-verified public content (e.g. that a collection point exists) may stay up if it's still of public interest, with no personal data of yours attached to it.
eliminarDatos.legalTexto: Requests are handled under Colombia's Ley 1581 de 2012 (Personal Data Protection Law / Habeas Data).
